description: Mint a fresh public/secret key pair for an EXISTING game (by gameId). Returns publicKey (pk_ — safe for the browser/widget) and secretKey (sk_ — server-only, shown ONCE; tell the developer to store it now). Use when a game needs keys, or to add another pair. Key revocation/rotation is done in the dashboard. Note: the secret also appears in this MCP host's tool-call transcript, so treat the conversation as sensitive until cleared.

gameId.description: UUID of the game to mint keys for (from list_games)

name: mint_key
